idea-plugin.name: Custom Sound Alert
idea-plugin.description:
Custom Sound Alert

Assign your own audio notifications to common IDE events so you can step away from the screen and still know what just happened.

  • Build success & build failure
  • All tests passed & one or more tests failed

Configure everything under Settings → Tools → Custom Sound Alert (or the Tools → Custom Sound Alert menu): pick a .wav or .mp3 file per event, set a global volume, and preview each sound with the Test button. Sounds play asynchronously and never block the IDE.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.3.0

  • Added a built-in success sound that plays on build/test success out of the box. Leave a success field blank to use it, or pick your own.

1.2.0

  • Added a built-in default sound for build/test failures — it plays out of the box until you choose your own file. Leave a failure field blank to use it.

1.1.3

  • The Custom Sound Alert entry now appears at the top of the Tools menu (like ADB Idea), instead of at the bottom.

1.1.2

  • Fixed: build sounds now fire in Android Studio / Gradle projects — including failed builds and broken build.gradle / sync errors — by listening to Gradle's external-system events (not just the JPS build pipeline).

1.1.1

  • Fixed: the Build failure sound now plays for failed builds that the IDE also reports as "aborted".
  • Added troubleshooting logs (in idea.log) for the build/test → sound path.

1.1.0

  • Renamed the settings page to Custom Sound Alert (was "SoundBuild").
  • Added a Tools → Custom Sound Alert menu with quick Settings… access and an Enable Sound Alerts toggle.

1.0.2

  • Fixed: the Settings → Tools → SoundBuild page now appears. (The extensions namespace attribute was wrong, so the settings page was never registered.)

1.0.1

  • Compatibility: removed the upper IDE bound so the plugin installs on newer releases, including Android Studio 2025.3 "Panda" (build 253) and later.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Custom sounds for build success/failure and test success/failure.
  • WAV and MP3 support, per-event Test button, and global volume control.
  • Settings persisted across IDE restarts.
